description: Passes one of two signals and switches between them on a trigger, the way a closed hi-hat cuts an open one short

params.text: Fades one of the two signals down, -1 to +1: at one end the first signal falls silent, at the other the second does, and at the centre both pass at full level

inputs.text: A rise here switches the output to the signal above this jack
The signal passed while the trigger below it was the last of the two to fire

outputs.text: Whichever of the two signals is selected

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
